examples.title: Factorial
examples.blurb: Recursive factorial from Maskit's 1994 thesis: node 0 computes 6! = 720 while node 1 idles.

examples.title: Remote Call
examples.blurb: Node 0 fires a one-way message and a typed remote call at node 1, then reads back the future.

examples.title: Futures
examples.blurb: Two remote calls are in flight simultaneously; the caller blocks only when each future is consumed.

examples.title: Suspension
examples.blurb: A nested call chain across both nodes suspends a process mid-expression while it waits on a future.

examples.title: Remote Bulk Transfer
examples.blurb: An eight-element array is bulk-copied to node 1, summed remotely, and the total is returned.

examples.title: Thread-Local Storage
examples.blurb: _Thread_local variables hold independent per-node values as the same function runs locally and remotely.

examples.title: Historical Hop
examples.blurb: Thesis Figure 3.3: a message hops around the node ring four times, counting visits as it goes.

examples.title: Historical Dirichlet
examples.blurb: Thesis Figures 5.3-5.5: a four-node ring relaxes neighbor values with a global barrier every timestep.

examples.title: Aggregates
examples.blurb: Single-node showcase of structs, unions, arrays, and pointer-linked nodes.

examples.title: Switch
examples.blurb: Single-node showcase of nested switches, Duff-style case placement, and fallthrough.

examples.title: Mesh 512
examples.blurb: A remote array sum invoked on node 511 of the full 8x8x8 mesh, the machine's largest configuration.

examples.title: Distributed Mandelbrot
examples.blurb: Four nodes render a 2x2 mosaic of 16x16 RGB tiles. Open Graphical Display to watch them.

examples.title: Rule 110
examples.blurb: A 32x24 space-time diagram of an elementary cellular automaton, rendered into node 0 memory.

examples.title: Message Hotspot
examples.blurb: Four senders converge on node 5 and paint progress columns. Inspect contention, queues, and the node 5 display.

examples.title: Mesh Rainbow
examples.blurb: Nodes 7, 56, 448, and 511 paint RGB tiles at distant corners of the 8x8x8 mesh.

examples.title: Life on Sixteen Nodes
examples.blurb: Conway's Life on a 16x16 torus split into sixteen 4x4 tiles. Node 15 collects edges and delivers halos; the mosaic shows the whole board.

examples.title: Heat Equation
examples.blurb: Jacobi relaxation of the heat equation on a 16x16 plate over sixteen nodes, with hot and cold spots held fixed. Returns the summed change of the last sweep.
